text:
Weekly review. The market light is RED (VIX 31). The S&P 500 is -6% since the plan began; chips are -18% this week and tech -12%. No new weekly picks are bought while the light is RED; only the VOO index core is allowed.
CORRECTION: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on 12 Nov (8-K filed; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO). FBI, congressional and company investigations plus a class action are ongoing. Earlier notes wrongly said he stayed on.
Under the agreed quality-dip rules, a CEO forced out over misconduct counts as a broken story even though revenue is at a record. Recommendation: sell NVDA. The automated quality score does not capture governance, so this is a manual story-break call.
AMD stays: its business story is intact, and its fall matches the market.
SNOW and CRWD sells still stand.

cautions.why: CEO resigned on 12 Nov amid an espionage-linked scandal; investigations and a class action are ongoing. Story broken: sell per the quality-dip rules.
